about: NQY Surf School is a Newquay surf school on Great Western Beach, led by Adam Griffiths, a four-time UK surf champion who has competed on the World Tour. Its surf centre, with changing rooms and lockers, is a few steps from the sand. It offers lessons for juniors, families and individuals, alongside bodyboarding, coasteering and an instructor course.
where: Surf centre on Great Western Beach, Newquay (TR7 2NE)
goodToKnow: Changing room and lockers at the surf centre
Book online or enquire by phone or email; booking terms are on the website
Accredited by Surfing England and AALA
gaps: No season, inclusions, what to bring, age limits or cancellation terms; the lessons page was not opened
